description: Connect ANOTHER of your own accounts to this key, alongside the ones already connected, and get its account_id. Send either `session` (a signed-in session string) or `identifier` and `password` (a sign-in). When the sign-in asks for a code or a check, the answer carries account_id and challenge_id: finish it with account_checkpoint. Refused with account_already_connected (and that account's account_id) when the same account is already here. Free. Session strings and passwords are credentials: pass them only when the user gives them. While GET /pricing does not list this route in its family's available_routes it answers 503 temporarily_unavailable and nothing is charged.

identifier.description: The account's sign-in email or phone.

proxy_url.description: Optional: your own http, https or socks5 proxy for this account.

remember.description: Optional opt-in: keep the sign-in details encrypted for automatic re-login.

session.description: The account's signed-in session string (or sign in with identifier and password).

totp_secret.description: Optional: the authenticator setup key (base32), so the two-factor code is typed for you.

user_agent.description: Optional: the browser user agent of the session or sign-in.

name: account_add
title: Connect Another Account
